wp01_findings.finding: Open-language chat entrypoints do not yet expose a durable external request identity owned by TurnRequestLedger.
wp01_findings.required_resolution: Add one durable request ledger before message append/graph invocation and prove retries create at most one Turn.

wp01_findings.finding: Transaction reconciliation returns a raw public dictionary instead of canonical RuntimeOutcome projection.
wp01_findings.required_resolution: Represent nothing-to-reconcile, reconciled, busy and failure states as typed RuntimeOutcome projections.

wp01_findings.finding: The plan compatibility cache is integrity-bound, but B30 still needs an explicit no-dispatch-with-cache-alone acceptance test.
wp01_findings.required_resolution: Prove all post-materialization dispatch reads require frozen_plan_definition plus plan_run.
